notes.title: New game mode coming soon
notes.content: [p]Hello,  [/p][p]This game is designed as a puzzle and combat game set within three layers of a maze, but I also have an idea to include a free exploration mode within a very large maze, featuring special areas where I can add new content over time. This new content will primarily consist of maze areas with specific themes that could be quite extensive. Currently, in this mode, there are no interactions or activities—just walking around and exploring the maze and special areas.    [/p][p][/p][p]This free exploration mode is planned to be released as a game update in approximately two weeks.    [/p][p][/p][p]Stay creative,   [/p][p]Reinhard [/p]
